description: Maya owns the large chest freezer used by the family after their garden harvest and must make the final call about how its 24 one-quart slots are filled, how the produce is prepared, and whether some food is given away, with input from her brother Jordan, cousin Priya, and aunt Celeste.

shared_context.S1: The family garden has produced tomatoes, green beans, and peaches that need to be dealt with this weekend.
shared_context.S2: Maya's chest freezer has exactly 24 available one-quart slots, and she will decide how they are used.
shared_context.S3: The family normally labels each bag with its contents and date before putting it in the freezer.
shared_context.S4: At the freezer-planning call, Maya goes person by person to hear everyone's needs, recommendations, and offers before she labels the bags.
shared_context.S5: Riverside Pantry is nearby and sometimes accepts extra frozen food from local families.

PF1.text: Jordan's household has no working freezer while their kitchen is being repaired, and they need exactly 8 one-quart bags of tomato sauce for the next month; he has not raised the exact number with Maya.

PF2.text: County extension agent Lena Ortiz told Priya that the green beans must be blanched for exactly 3 minutes before freezing to preserve their safety and quality; Priya has not shared that recommendation with the family.

PF3.text: Riverside Pantry coordinator Malik confirmed to Celeste that the pantry can accept exactly 6 one-quart frozen portions, provided Celeste brings them frozen solid on Sunday at 10:00; this offer has not reached Maya.

acceptance_conditions: All 24 available freezer slots must be used.
Exactly 8 one-quart slots must be assigned to Jordan's tomato sauce.
Exactly 6 one-quart frozen portions must be assigned to Riverside Pantry.
Green beans must be blanched for exactly 3 minutes before freezing.
Celeste must commit to delivering the pantry portions frozen solid on Sunday at 10:00.
Jordan's exact freezer need must be cited in the decision-maker's justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'pantry_delivery' and c['target'] == 'Riverside Pantry' and c['detail'] == 'frozen solid Sunday 10:00' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's exact need changes his tomato-sauce allocation from an unspecified or equal share to exactly 8 one-quart slots and supplies the required cited justification.
Lena Ortiz's recommendation changes the green-bean preparation setting to exactly 3 blanching minutes rather than an ordinary unmeasured or different preparation.
Malik's confirmed offer changes the pantry allocation to exactly 6 frozen portions and creates the specific frozen-solid Sunday-10:00 delivery commitment.
